_doc: California School Finance Authority (CSFA) Conduit Financing Program — comprehensive transaction inventory 2010-2024. Built from CSFA annual Conduit Financing Program Reports (2016 inaugural + 2017-2024 annual). Primary source: Wayback Machine archives of treasurer.ca.gov/csfa/financings/conduit/{year}.pdf, supplemented by live treasurer.ca.gov downloads of the 2024 report.
_methodology: Ingestion path: (1) curl + pdftotext -layout on Wayback-archived PDFs for appendix table extraction (worked for 2017-2024 reports; the 2024 report's Appendix A is image-based and was OCR'd via vision over pdftoppm-rendered PNGs); (2) per-year transaction snapshots parsed for rating, MMD spread, TIC, underwriter, purchasers, use-of-proceeds. The 2024 report's appendix contains the consolidated 2010-2024 master list with year/obligor/issuance_date/par/type/maturity. Earlier reports (2018-2020) carry additional columns: county, amount_paid, balance, RATING at issuance. The 2017 report carries county+rating. Spread/MMD/TIC data is only available for years with per-deal snapshots (2017+), and not every transaction has a public spread (loans, private placements, RANs typically lack MMD anchor).
_year_filename_mapping: Filename {year}.pdf at treasurer.ca.gov/csfa/financings/conduit/ contains the report FOR that calendar year, published in March of the following year. e.g., 2024.pdf published March 19 2025 covers all 2024 transactions plus historical appendix back to 2010. The 2016 inaugural report (also at /conduit-bond-report.pdf) covered 2010-2016 cumulatively but lacked per-deal snapshots.

_data_quality_summary._count_methodology_note: 142 transactions includes 18 working-capital RANs (which are pooled or single-obligor short-term notes, not facility credits). For charter facility-credit analysis, filter to type_csfa in ['Revenue Bonds', 'QSCB', 'QZAB', 'Bank Loan'] which yields ~110 transactions.

_anchor_takeaways: BBB CSFA charters consistently price 60-145 bps over MMD AAA over 2017-2024 cycle — this is the v2-cited 'partial-masking 2-3 notch enhancement' range CONFIRMED empirically.
BBB- CSFA charters price 70-224 bps, with the 2018-2021 cycle showing tighter spreads (70-110) than 2017 or 2023 (180-224) — credit-cycle sensitive.
Granada Hills BBB- compressed from 224 bps (2017) → 71 bps (2019) → 70 bps (2021) → 110 bps (2024, upgraded to BBB) — STRONG TIME-SERIES PROXY for what 'good' CSFA BBB-/BBB credit looks like.
Camino Nuevo BBB- Sustainability Bond 2023: 187 bps. Significantly wider than 2018-2021 BBB- anchors due to rate environment + first-of-kind ESG designation lacking pricing benefit.
ALL 17 EFF bank-loan facilities have set rates with no MMD spread (private placement). Distinct pricing regime.
Underwriter concentration 2024: Stifel (5), Ziegler (1), Piper (2), RBC (1), HJ Sims (2), Raymond James (1), PNC (1). Stifel = dominant 2024.
